```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| context: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

chamber_levels <- c(
  "c_1_amb", "c_2_amb", "c_3_e0.75", "c_4_e1.5", "c_5_e2.25",
  "c_6_e2.25", "c_7_e3.0", "c_8_e3.75", "c_9_e3.75",
  "c_10_e4.5", "c_11_e5.25", "c_12_e6.0"
)

color.gradient <- c(
  "blue4", "blue3", "turquoise4", "lightseagreen",
  "mediumseagreen", "limegreen", "yellowgreen", "yellow2",
  "darkgoldenrod2", "darkorange2", "orangered1", "red2"
)

start_cutoff <- 220 # Buffer of time after flux window
end_cutoff <- 510

# For testing
input <- list()
input$gases <- c("CH₄", "CO₂", "N₂O", "H₂O")
input$today <- Sys.Date()
input$days_to_plot <- 3
input$daily <- "Hourly"
input$smooth <- "Measured"
input$metrics <- "NEE"
input$compare_years <- "Compare years"
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Code for plots
################ FLUXES ####################
# This file has BOTH fluxes and partitioned GPP/R
partitioned <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_flux_data/refs/heads/master/processed_data/partitioned_co2.csv", show_col_types = F) %>%
  mutate(
    GPP = ifelse(!is_day & !is.na(NEE), 0, GPP),
    CH4 = ifelse(CH4 < -0.2, NA, CH4)
  ) %>%
  mutate(DateTime = with_tz(DateTime, "EST"),
         flux_time = with_tz(flux_time, "EST"),
         driver_time = with_tz(driver_time, "EST"))

updateDateInput(
  inputId = "today",
  max = as_date(max(partitioned$DateTime)),
  value = as_date(max(partitioned$DateTime))
)

updateNumericInput(
  inputId = "days_to_plot",
  max = round(as.numeric(difftime(as_date(max(partitioned$DateTime)),
    "2025-03-18",
    units = "days"
  ))),
  value = 5
)

output$plot_flux <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(DateTime)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(DateTime) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      )
  } else {
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        as_date(DateTime) <= input$today,
        DateTime > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      )
  }
  
  part_recent2 <- part_recent %>%
    select(c(CH4, N2O, NEE, DateTime, Chamber)) %>%
    pivot_longer(matches("CH4|N2O|NEE"),
      names_to = "gas"
    ) %>%
    mutate(gas = gas %>%
             replace_values(
               "CH4" ~ "CH₄",
               "CO2" ~ "CO₂",
               "N2O" ~ "N₂O"
             ),
           year = year(DateTime)) %>%
    filter(!gas == "Flag")

  if (input$daily == "Daily mean") {
    part_recent3 <- part_recent2 %>%
      mutate(
        DateTime = as_date(DateTime),
        DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime)
      ) %>%
      group_by(DateTime, Chamber, gas, year) %>%
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    part_recent3 <- part_recent2
  }

  p1 <- part_recent3 %>%
    mutate(
      Chamber = factor(Chamber,
        levels = 1:12,
        labels = chamber_levels
      ),
      gas = ifelse(gas == "NEE", "CO₂", gas)
    ) %>%
    filter(gas %in% input$gases) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = DateTime, y = value, color = Chamber)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    {
      if (input$smooth == "Smoothed") {
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "gam")
      } else {
        geom_line()
      }
    } +
    ylab("Flux (µmol/m²/s)") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(gas~year, scales = "free")
      } else {
        facet_wrap(~gas, scales = "free_y")
      }
    } +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("Chamber", "DateTime", "value")) %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        tracegroupgap = 0
      )
    )
})


################ PARTITIONED CO2 ####################

# Code for plots
output$plot_co2 <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(DateTime)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(DateTime) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      )
  } else {
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        as_date(DateTime) <= input$today,
        DateTime > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      )
  }
  
  part_recent2 <- part_recent %>%
    select(c(NEE, GPP, Reco, DateTime, Chamber)) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(NEE, GPP, Reco),
      names_to = "gas"
    ) %>%
    mutate(value = ifelse(gas == "GPP", -value, value),
           year = year(DateTime)) %>%
    filter(!gas == "Flag")

  if (input$daily == "Daily mean") {
    part_recent3 <- part_recent2 %>%
      mutate(
        DateTime = as_date(DateTime),
        DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime)
      ) %>%
      group_by(DateTime, Chamber, gas, year) %>%
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    part_recent3 <- part_recent2
  }

  p1 <- part_recent3 %>%
    mutate(Chamber = factor(Chamber,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = chamber_levels
    )) %>%
    filter(gas %in% input$metrics) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = DateTime, y = value, color = Chamber)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    {
      if (input$smooth == "Smoothed") {
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "gam")
      } else {
        geom_line()
      }
    } +
    ylab("Flux (µmol/m²/s)") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(gas~year, scales = "free")
      } else {
        facet_wrap(~gas, nrow = 1)
      }
    } +
    scale_color_manual(values = color.gradient) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("Chamber", "DateTime", "value")) %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        tracegroupgap = 0
      )
    )
})

################ WATER LEVEL ####################
wl <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_flux_data/refs/heads/master/processed_data/water_level_dashboard.csv")
output$plot_wl <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    wl_recent <- wl %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(TIMESTAMP)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(TIMESTAMP) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(Depth_cm:Salinity_PSU),
                   names_to = "variable"
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = year(TIMESTAMP))
  } else {
    wl_recent <- wl %>%
      filter(
        as_date(TIMESTAMP) <= input$today,
        TIMESTAMP > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(Depth_cm:Salinity_PSU),
                   names_to = "variable"
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = year(TIMESTAMP))
  }

  if (input$daily == "Daily mean") {
    wl_recent2 <- wl_recent %>%
      mutate(
        TIMESTAMP = as_date(TIMESTAMP),
        TIMESTAMP = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP)
      ) %>%
      group_by(TIMESTAMP, variable, year) %>%
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    wl_recent2 <- wl_recent
  }

  p1 <- wl_recent2 %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = value)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    {
      if (input$smooth == "Smoothed") {
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "gam")
      } else {
        geom_line()
      }
    } +
    ylab("Value") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(variable~year, scales = "free")
      } else {
        facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")
      }
    } +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTAMP", "value"))
})

################ SOIL TEMP ####################
soil_temp <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_flux_data/refs/heads/master/processed_data/soil_temp_daily.csv")
output$plot_soil_temp <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    st_recent <- soil_temp %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(Date)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(Date) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = year(Date))
  } else {
    st_recent <- soil_temp %>%
      filter(
        as_date(Date) <= input$today,
        Date > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = year(Date))
  }

  p1 <- st_recent %>%
    mutate(Chamber = factor(Chamber,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = chamber_levels
    )) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = SoilTemp_25cm_C, color = Chamber)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    {
      if (input$smooth == "Smoothed") {
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "gam")
      } else {
        geom_line()
      }
    } +
    ylab("Value") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(.~year, scales = "free")
      } 
    } +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_color_manual(values = color.gradient) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTAMP", "Chamber", "SoilTemp_25cm_C"))
})

################ FORECAST ####################
# Code for plots
output$plot_forecast <- renderPlotly({
  forecast <- read_csv(paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_CH4cast/refs/heads/master/outputs/daily-", input$today, "-slosh.csv.gz"),
    show_col_types = F
  )
  
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    date_2025 <- yday(input$today) - 1 + as_date("2025-01-01")
    forecast_2025 <- read_csv(paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_CH4cast/refs/heads/master/outputs/daily-", format(date_2025, "%Y-%m-%d"), "-slosh.csv.gz"),
                              show_col_types = F
    )
    forecast <- forecast %>%
      bind_rows(forecast_2025) %>%
      mutate(year = year(datetime))
    
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(DateTime)) <= yday(input$today + days(7)),
        yday(DateTime) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      )
  } else {
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        as_date(DateTime) <= (input$today + days(7)),
        DateTime > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      )
  }

  part_recent2 <- part_recent %>%
    select(c(CH4, DateTime, Chamber)) %>%
    pivot_longer(matches("CH4"),
      names_to = "gas"
    ) %>%
    filter(!gas == "Flag") %>%
    mutate(year = year(DateTime),
           DateTime = as_date(DateTime),
           DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime)
    ) %>%
    group_by(DateTime, Chamber, gas, year) %>%
    summarize(
      value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p1 <- forecast %>%
    mutate(
      Chamber = factor(site_id, levels = 1:12, labels = chamber_levels),
      site_id = factor(site_id, levels = 1:12, labels = chamber_levels)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "parameter", values_from = "prediction") %>%
    rename(
      value = mu,
      DateTime = datetime
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = DateTime, y = value, color = Chamber, fill = site_id)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = value - sigma, ymax = value + sigma), alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_point(
      data = part_recent2 %>%
        mutate(
          site_id = factor(Chamber, levels = 1:12, labels = chamber_levels),
          Chamber = site_id
        ),
      aes(x = DateTime, y = value), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels,
      name = "Chamber"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels,
      name = "Chamber"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    ) +
    ylab("Flux (µmol/m²/day)")
  
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    p1 <- p1 +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = today),
                 data = data.frame(
                   today = c(input$today,
                             date_2025),
                   year = c(2026, 2025))) +
      facet_wrap(~year, scales = "free_x") +
      ggtitle(paste0("CH₄ forecasts for ", format(input$today,
                                                  "%d %B")))
  } else {
    p1 <- p1 + geom_vline(xintercept = input$today) +
      ggtitle(paste0("CH₄ forecasts for ", input$today))
  }

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("site_id", "DateTime", "value")) %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        tracegroupgap = 0
      )
    )
})

################ FLUX, WL comp ####################
# Code for plots

output$flux_wl <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(DateTime)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(DateTime) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      )
  } else {
    part_recent <- partitioned %>%
      filter(
        as_date(DateTime) <= input$today,
        DateTime > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      )
  }
  
  part_wl <- part_recent %>%
    select(DateTime, Chamber, CH4, Depth_cm) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(CH4, Depth_cm), names_to = "variable") %>%
    mutate(variable = case_match(variable,
                                 "CH4"~"CH₄",
                                 .default = variable),
           Chamber = ifelse(variable == "Depth_cm",
                            NA, Chamber),
           year = year(DateTime)) %>%
    select(c(DateTime, Chamber, value, variable, year))

  if (input$daily == "Daily mean") {
    part_wl2 <- part_wl %>%
      mutate(
        DateTime = as_date(DateTime),
        DateTime = as.POSIXct(DateTime)
      ) %>%
      group_by(DateTime, Chamber, variable, year) %>%
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    part_wl2 <- part_wl
  }

  p1 <- part_wl2 %>%
    mutate(Chamber = factor(Chamber,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = chamber_levels
    )) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = DateTime, y = value, color = Chamber)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    {
      if (input$smooth == "Smoothed") {
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "gam")
      } else {
        geom_line()
      }
    } +
    ylab("Value") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(variable~year, scales = "free")
      } else {
        facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")
      }
    } +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("Chamber", "DateTime", "value")) %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        tracegroupgap = 0
      )
    )
})

################ Raw data ####################
raw <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_flux_data/refs/heads/master/processed_data/raw_for_dashboard.csv")

updateSelectInput(
  inputId = "raw_date",
  label = "Date",
  choices = as_date((Sys.Date() - days(7)):Sys.Date()),
  selected = Sys.Date()
)

output$plot_raw <- renderPlotly({
  raw_plot <- raw %>%
    filter(
      as_date(TIMESTAMP) == input$raw_date,
      Chamber == input$raw_chamber
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(matches("CH4d_ppm|N2Od_ppm|CO2d_ppm"),
      names_to = "gas"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gas = case_match(gas,
        "CH4d_ppm" ~ "CH₄",
        "CO2d_ppm" ~ "CO₂",
        "N2Od_ppm" ~ "N₂O",
        .default = gas
      ),
      Chamber = factor(Chamber,
        levels = 1:12,
        labels = chamber_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(label = format(min(TIMESTAMP), "%H:%M:%S"))

  p1 <- raw_plot %>%
    mutate(used = ifelse(Manifold_Timer >= start_cutoff &
      Manifold_Timer <= end_cutoff,
    "yes",
    "no"
    )) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = TIMESTAMP, y = value,
      alpha = used, shape = used,
      color = Chamber
    )) +
    geom_point(size = .9) +
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(1, 0.1),
      breaks = c("yes", "no")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(21, 19),
      breaks = c("no", "yes")
    ) +
    ylab("Value") +
    facet_grid(gas ~ label, scales = "free") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    ) +
    ggtitle(unique(raw_plot$Chamber))

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTEP", "value"))
})

output$plot_time <- renderPlotly({
  raw_plot <- raw %>%
    pivot_longer(matches("CH4d_ppm|N2Od_ppm|CO2d_ppm"),
      names_to = "gas"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gas = case_match(gas,
        "CH4d_ppm" ~ "CH₄",
        "CO2d_ppm" ~ "CO₂",
        "N2Od_ppm" ~ "N₂O",
        .default = gas
      ),
      Chamber = factor(Chamber,
        levels = 1:12,
        labels = chamber_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(label = format(min(TIMESTAMP), "%H:%M:%S"))

  raw_plot2 <- raw_plot %>%
    filter(
      as_date(TIMESTAMP) == input$raw_date,
      hour(TIMESTAMP) == as.numeric(input$time_hour)
    )

  p1 <- raw_plot2 %>%
    mutate(used = ifelse(Manifold_Timer >= start_cutoff &
      Manifold_Timer <= end_cutoff,
    "yes",
    "no"
    )) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      min_TS = min(TIMESTAMP),
      secs = as.numeric(difftime(TIMESTAMP, min_TS, units = "secs"))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = secs, y = value,
      alpha = used, shape = used,
      color = Chamber
    )) +
    geom_point(size = .9) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = paste(group, gas, Chamber), x = secs, y = value),
      method = "lm", se = F, color = "black",
      data = . %>% filter(used == "yes"),
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(1, 0.2),
      breaks = c("yes", "no")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(21, 19),
      breaks = c("no", "yes")
    ) +
    ylab("Value") +
    xlab("Seconds since start time") +
    facet_wrap(~gas, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme( # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    ) +
    ggtitle(input$time_date)

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("TIMESTEP", "value", "Chamber"))
})

#### Errors

errors_df <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abbylewis/GENX_flux_data/refs/heads/master/processed_data/error_codes.csv") %>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP = force_tz(TIMESTAMP, "EST"))

output$plot_errors <- renderPlotly({
  if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
    errors_recent <- errors_df %>%
      filter(
        yday(as_date(TIMESTAMP)) <= yday(input$today),
        yday(TIMESTAMP) > (yday(input$today) - input$days_to_plot)
      )
  } else {
    errors_recent <- errors_df %>%
      filter(
        as_date(TIMESTAMP) <= input$today,
        as_date(TIMESTAMP) > (input$today - days(input$days_to_plot))
      )
  }
  
  errors <- errors_recent %>%
    select(TIMESTAMP, Chamber, Diag_7810, Diag_7820) %>%
    mutate(year = year(TIMESTAMP)) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Diag_7810, Diag_7820),
                 names_to = "variable")

  if (input$daily == "Daily mean") {
    errors2 <- errors %>%
      mutate(
        TIMESTAMP = as_date(TIMESTAMP),
        TIMESTAMP = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP)
      ) %>%
      group_by(TIMESTAMP, year, variable) %>%
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    errors2 <- errors
  }

  p1 <- errors2 %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = value)) +
    geom_line() +
    ylab("Value") +
    {
      if(input$compare_years == "Compare years"){
        facet_grid(variable~year, scales = "free")
      } else {
        facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")
      }
    } +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color.gradient,
      breaks = chamber_levels
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1.0, hjust = 1.0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey")
    )

  plotly::ggplotly(p1, tooltip = c("Chamber", "TIMESTAMP", "value")) %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        tracegroupgap = 0
      )
    )
})

# Add an observer at the end of server setup
observe({
  # Wait until all data is loaded
  req(nrow(raw) > 0)

  # Hide the overlay using JavaScript
  session$sendCustomMessage("hideLoadingOverlay", TRUE)
})
```
